name: Iridescence That Ceased Amidst Glory
description: It was a flower made of silk, gifted to her by a friend whose hands were as cold as ice.

name: Sharpness That Ceased Upon Wondrous Creation
description: It was a feathered quill given to her followers, once used to pen the most absurd of dreams.

name: Moment That Ceased Upon Waking From Grand Dreams
description: It was a fleeting moment she gave a certain silent alchemist to remind him of every item on his schedule.

name: Ovations That Ceased Upon Festivity
description: It was a goblet of wine she had accepted in celebration from the hands of a colleague.

name: Pendulum That Ceased Amidst a Great Fall
description: It was a delicate trinket awarded to her in praise by the hand of her only master.
